user.title: Connect your Sonnen Battery
user.description: Turn on the JSON API in the battery's dashboard (Software-Integration) and copy the API token. Enable write access too if you want to change the operating mode or backup reserve from Home Assistant.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the battery, e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The battery at {host} rejected the API token. Enter the current token from its dashboard.

data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the battery, e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.api_token: The token shown under Software-Integration in the battery's dashboard

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the battery. Check the host and that the JSON API is turned on.
error.invalid_auth: The battery rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This battery is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That's a different battery from the one this entry is for.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between readings. Shorter intervals make the energy counters more accurate.

write_failed.message: The battery didn't accept the change. Check that write access is enabled for the API token.

setpoint_failed.message: The battery didn't accept the power setpoint. It must be in manual operating mode, and write access must be enabled for the API token.

entry_not_found.message: That Sonnen Battery isn't set up.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Sonnen Battery isn't loaded right now.

auth_failed.message: The battery rejected the API token.

update_failed.message: Couldn't read data from the battery: {error}

set_power.name: Set battery power
set_power.description: Charges or discharges the battery at a fixed power. Only works in manual operating mode. Set 0 W to stop.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Charge into the battery, or discharge out of it.

power.name: Power
power.description: Power in watts. The battery limits this to what its inverter can do.
